name: eelwife
desc: A quayside eel-seller in her fifties who shouts a price at everyone on principle: square-shouldered and formidable, wind-chapped cheeks, iron-grey hair scraped back under a slate-blue headscarf, a shrewd amused squint, forearms like a rower's. She wears a teal-grey oilskin smock over a heavy blue-grey knit, a rubberised apron beaded with water, and a pair of scaling tongs pushed through her belt; a smoked eel hangs from a hook beside her. Loud, dry, secretly generous.
sheetHint: square-shouldered, iron-grey hair under a slate-blue headscarf, teal-grey oilskin smock, blue-grey knit, wet rubberised apron, scaling tongs in belt
